_comment: Copy to secrets.json (gitignored). Values here override config.json. monthly_budget_usd is only a FALLBACK. The daemon fetches official spend/limit from claude.ai: first the OAuth token in ~/.claude/.credentials.json, then a browser sessionKey. On enterprise/SSO logins the OAuth token is often stale and never refreshes, so set session_key + org_id (below) for accurate data.
_session_note: session_key: copy from claude.ai browser cookie 'sessionKey' (DevTools > Application > Cookies). org_id: your organization UUID from https://claude.ai/api/organizations. If omitted here, the daemon also reads these from ~/.claude/claude_usage_config.json (written by the mews:claude-usage skill).
